mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{tenantKey}, #{externalSubscriptionId}, #{externalCustomerId}, #{status}, #{planId}, #{currentPeriodStart}, #{currentPeriodEnd}, #{cancelAtPeriodEnd}, #{canceledAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now())) ON CONFLICT (external_subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, current_period_start = EXCLUDED.current_period_start, current_period_end = EXCLUDED.current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end = EXCLUDED.cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at = EXCLUDED.canceled_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unpaid') ORDER BY current_period_end DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, status, plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC
